Class DEditDataType

java.lang.Object
  |
  +--model.DEditDataType
public class DEditDataType
extends java.lang.Object

XML Editor version of a schema simple data type w/ or w/o restriction

          Type to be used for a constrained value (type="xsd:integer" etc.) which may have limits (minimum value, maximum value, etc.) specified in the constructor.

Constructor Detail

DEditDataType

public DEditDataType(int type,
                     int datatype,
                     java.lang.String defaultValue,
                     java.util.Vector values)
Creates a DEditDataType given the pertinent information

Parameters:
type - the general type of the value to be edited with respect to how it is edited, one of DEditDataType. FIXED, CONSTRAINT, CHOICE, or EPSILON.
datatype - the basic type of data in terms of int, boolean, float, string, etc. Currently supported are: DEditDataType.STRING (xsd:string) DEditDataType.BOOLEAN (xsd:boolean) DEditDataType.INTEGER (xsd:integer) DEditDataType.FLOAT (xsd:float) DEditDataType.URI (xsd:anyURI) For now, anything else is treated as an xsd:string.
